rulesGuide.title: Change path, command, and tool rules here
rulesGuide.body: Run mode only decides whether to ask for confirm. Use the three blocks below to block extra files, commands, or tools. No rules means no extra limits. Changes apply immediately.

security.runModeAskDesc: Ask before editing files, running commands, or using the network
security.runModeAutoDesc: Do not ask; workspace isolation still applies
security.autoWarn: This mode will not ask per action. The agent can run on its own. Workspace isolation and allow/deny rules below still apply. Only use it if you trust the current task.
security.credHint: Do not send API keys, tokens, or passwords in chat. Configure them in the matching service settings.
security.tierWorkspaceDesc: Can write only the workspace and this run’s temp dir
security.tierDangerDesc: Each run still asks for confirm
security.noticeShellFull: Files outside the workspace cannot be read.
security.noticeShellNone: Files outside the workspace can still be read.
security.noticeShellUnknown: Cannot confirm whether files outside the workspace are readable.
security.noticeDenyPartial: Deny rules are only partly enforced: platform limits, or more than 512 rules.
security.noticeDenyUnknown: Cannot confirm whether deny rules are fully enforced.
security.isolationSaveFailed: Failed to save workspace isolation tier.
security.allowWorkspaceScripts: Allow existing scripts in the workspace
security.allowWorkspaceScriptsHint: Only scripts that already exist in the workspace. Delete, shutdown, and outbound actions are still denied.
security.fileAccessHint: Limit which paths the agent can read or write. Glob is supported, e.g. deny /etc/* or allow ~/Downloads/*.pdf. Empty means no extra limits beyond workspace isolation.
security.commandHint: Block shell commands by pattern, e.g. rm -rf *. Matches are denied without asking. This cannot auto-allow a command.
security.toolPermHint: Block named tools; this is not auto-run. Match by tool name (e.g. bash_exec). A match denies the call and will not show an execute confirm. Names match Settings → Tools.
security.noToolMatch: No matches. Clear the filter and try again.
security.registryOffline: Could not load the tool registry (backend must be online). You can still type a name. Full list is under Settings → Tools.
security.computerUseSaved: Saved to local config. Fully quit Near and reopen (do not just close the window). The built-in assistant restarts with the app and loads the new setting. In remote mode under Settings → Remote connection, sync this on the server and restart the remote service.
security.computerUseIntro: Writes computer_use.enabled in ~/.agenticx/config.yaml. When on, the assistant Near starts with the app tries to load desktop capabilities. If you still do not see those tools, install a Near build that includes them. Fully quit and reopen after changing (see the save note for remote mode).
security.enableComputerUse: Enable computer use (desktop screenshot / input; needs permissions and deps)
security.policyLoadFailed: Failed to load skill install policy.
security.policySaved: Saved. For bundle or ClawHub installs, whether to skip confirm is decided by this switch plus the pre-install scan (same config as the backend).
security.scanConfigLoadFailed: Failed to load security scan settings.
security.autoInstallDesc: A static rule scan still runs and shows a summary. Install can finish without extra confirm only if no high-risk rules match. High risk always needs your confirm.
security.scanIntro: Marketplace, bundle, and extension installs are scanned first. High risk needs your confirm. Use Scan installed skills below to re-check what is already installed. Writes ~/.agenticx/config.yaml; restart to apply.
security.engineV1: Engine v1: classic regex rules, same as older versions.
security.engineV2: Engine v2: YAML rule pack, depth by skill size, 0–100 score and grade. More complete (recommended).
security.scanModeHint: Scan mode (v2 only for install): Quick — SKILL.md, skip heavy checks; Standard — depth from file count (default); Full — scan as much of the tree and deps as possible, slower and stricter.
security.scanInstalledHint: Scans each skill and lists only problems. Report only; nothing is changed automatically.
security.needEnableManage: Turn on “Allow the assistant to edit local skills” in Skills settings first
security.aiFixHint: Delegate a new meta-agent session to fix; a diff is shown before write
security.externalReadonly: External sources are read-only. You can disable or ignore them.
security.restoreBackupTitle: Restore the snapshot saved before this AI fix
security.disableTitle: The model will not load this skill. The files stay.
security.ignoreTitle: Later scans skip this skill by default
security.enableManageFirst: Turn on “Allow the assistant to edit local skills” in Skills settings before using AI fix.
security.missingSkillDir: Skill folder is missing. Cannot delegate a fix.
security.backupSkipped: Backup was not created ({{error}}). Fix will continue.
security.createMetaFailed: Failed to create a meta-agent session
security.hooksIntro: Hooks run custom scripts at points in the agent loop — to change behavior, enforce policy, or log.
security.presetHint: Enable preset paths to import hooks from Cursor / Claude Code and similar tools.

knowledge.restartNeededBody: Packages such as socksio were just installed, but this backend started before that. Fully quit Near (⌘Q) and reopen, then click ⟳ on failed files to rebuild. No need to repair again.
knowledge.pyEnvIncomplete: The backend Python environment is incomplete
knowledge.pyEnvHint: Embedding may use a local proxy (e.g. SOCKS). Missing socksio shows up as a failure after upload. Open Config on the left, click One-click repair at the top, then Restart now; or click ⟳ on the failed file.
knowledge.dropHint: Drop files here, or click to choose ({{extensions}})
knowledge.emptyDocs: Empty. Drop a Markdown file to run the first search.
knowledge.reindexNeedRepair: Use One-click repair in Knowledge settings at the top, then Restart now, then click ⟳ on this file.
knowledge.reindexNeedRestart: Deps are installed. If you just repaired, this backend may have started earlier. Fully quit Near (⌘Q), reopen, then click ⟳.
knowledge.debugIntro: Check retrieval quality and chunking here. This does not change ingested materials. Save Config first after changing settings.
knowledge.testQuestionHint: Press Enter to run. Use a full question so you can see which chunks come back.
knowledge.testQuestionPh: e.g. Which vector store does the knowledge base use by default?
knowledge.noSearchDetail: Pick a channel, enter a question, then Run search to see ranked chunks and sources.
knowledge.noHitsDetail: Try another wording, raise Top-K, switch to hybrid, or confirm materials ingested successfully.
knowledge.chunkLocalOnly: Parses a local file for preview only — nothing is written to the vector store. Strategy from Config: {{strategy}}
knowledge.overlapHint: Overlap between neighbors to reduce mid-sentence cuts
knowledge.noPreviewDetail: Enter a readable absolute path, adjust size and overlap, then Preview chunks.
knowledge.noChunksDetail: Check that the path exists, the extension is supported, and the file has readable text.
knowledge.networkHint: Confirm Near’s local backend (agx serve) is running, and this knowledge base is saved and enabled.
knowledge.embedChanged: ⚠️ Embedding model or dimension changed. Rebuild the index on the Materials page before searching again.
knowledge.ollamaMissing: Ollama or the model was not found at {{url}}. You can still save (start Ollama later), or switch to OpenAI / SiliconFlow / Bailian.
knowledge.embedModelPh: Fetch embedding models in Model providers and mark them visible first
knowledge.embedModelHint: In Model providers, fetch models and mark embedding models visible. They will appear here.
knowledge.ollamaKeyOptional: Local Ollama can leave this empty
knowledge.onlineKeyPh: Paste an API key for Bailian / OpenAI / SiliconFlow
knowledge.probeTitle: Send a test embedding request to check key, model, and dimension
knowledge.embedChangeHint: After changing the embedding model, save will remind you to rebuild. It does not delete the vector store.
knowledge.restoreExtTitle: Restore Near’s built-in list (including LiteParse Office, sheets, and images)
knowledge.retrievalHint: Smart / always search for chat is set in Chat retrieval above. This only configures this brain’s index and channel.
knowledge.smartHint: Smart: the model decides when to search, including when you ask to search the knowledge base. Always: search before every answer.
knowledge.wikiCompileDesc: After ingest, generate structured wiki pages
knowledge.synthesisDesc: Merge multiple hits into one sourced answer
knowledge.builtinDetail: Plain text, PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML, JSON, CSV, YAML
knowledge.liteparseMissing: Legacy Office, sheets, and images cannot be parsed. Install:
knowledge.loHintMissing: Needed for legacy Office and sheets. Install:
knowledge.repairInstalling: Installing knowledge-base and document-parse deps (may take a few minutes)…
knowledge.repairRestart: Backend deps repaired. Fully quit and restart Near.
knowledge.depsMissing: Knowledge-base / document-parse backend deps are missing
knowledge.embeddedBroken: Embedded backend found but the dep check failed. The install is likely broken; reinstall the app.
knowledge.repairHint: Repair creates ~/.agenticx/.venv and installs agenticx[desktop-runtime] (chromadb, PDF parse, SOCKS socksio, etc.).
knowledge.purposePh: Describe this brain’s goal and bounds for wiki compile…
knowledge.noWiki: No compiled pages yet. Enable Wiki compile in Config and finish ingest.
knowledge.defaultModeHint: Default for new chats. A session can still switch next to the composer.
knowledge.modeSmartHint: The model decides when to search the knowledge base
knowledge.modeAlwaysHint: Search the knowledge base before answering

connectors.intro: Connect accounts and services so Near can use them after you authorize.
connectors.showUnavailableAria: Show connectors that are not integrated yet
connectors.tmeetHint: Uses the official Tencent Meeting CLI device-code flow. Connect opens the official scan page in your browser. The CLI stores credentials encrypted locally. Near never reads your meeting password.
connectors.githubHint: Uses the official GitHub CLI (gh) device flow. After connect, Near writes a hosted skill so the agent can query repos, issues, and pull requests via gh. Credentials stay in gh on this machine.
connectors.githubPaste: github.com/login/device is open. Paste this code and authorize.
connectors.feishuHint: Uses the official Feishu CLI (lark-cli) in two steps: create a Feishu app in the browser once, then user authorize. Near writes a hosted skill so the agent can use messages, docs, bitable, calendar, and tasks. Credentials stay in the CLI.
connectors.feishuOpenHint: If the browser did not open, use the button above to continue.
connectors.wecomHint: Uses the official WeCom CLI (wecom-cli). Create an API-mode bot in the WeCom admin console, then paste Bot ID and Secret. Near writes a hosted skill for messages, docs, sheets, contacts, todos, and meetings. Credentials are encrypted by the CLI.
connectors.howBotCreds: How to get Bot ID / Secret
connectors.qqmailHint: Agently Mail is a QQ Mail team inbox for agents (isolated from personal QQ Mail). After WeChat scan via agently-cli, Near writes a hosted skill so the agent can send, search, reply, and forward. Admin:
connectors.openOrCopy: Open or copy this link to finish authorization:
connectors.tapdHint: Enter a TAPD personal access token to manage stories, bugs, tasks, iterations, and workflows.
connectors.howTapd: How to get a TAPD token?
connectors.tapdTokenHint: Create one in TAPD → Personal settings → Personal access tokens. The token is not written to chat history.
connectors.needTapdToken: Enter a TAPD personal access token
connectors.tmeetIncomplete: Tencent Meeting authorization did not finish
connectors.qqmailIncomplete: Agent Mail authorization did not finish
connectors.tapdRefreshFail: TAPD is connected, but status refresh failed. Close settings and reopen.
connectors.tapdDisconnectedStale: TAPD is disconnected, but status refresh failed. Close settings and reopen.

codeIndex.indexText: Index Markdown and other text files

brains.intro: Each brain is a separate instance (docs or code). Avatars can mount 0–N brains. Meta uses global brains by default.
brains.name: Name
brains.deleteConfirm: Delete brain “{{name}}”? This cannot be undone.
brains.chatRetrievalSaveFailed: Failed to save chat retrieval settings
brains.savedDebug: Saved. You can keep debugging or testing on this page.
brains.metaDefault: Meta can use it by default. Avatars mount global brains by default and can also pick mounts in avatar settings.
brains.ownerOnlyHint: and its mount policy; Meta does not see it by default.
brains.systemFixedGlobal: The system default document library is always global. It cannot be avatar-only.
brains.globalVisibleHint: Near (Meta) and avatars can search it. Good for shared docs and code.
brains.privateVisibleHint: Only the bound avatar sees it by default. Meta will not auto-mount it.
brains.noFolderPicker: This client cannot pick a folder. Restart the desktop app and try again.

dataSources.ifindHint: Needs an enterprise iFinD account and SDK. This only lists APIs; credentials cannot be set yet.
dataSources.notEnabled: Data source is disabled or missing

memoryArchive.title: Turn memory
memoryArchive.intro: After each turn, user/assistant semantic chunks are written to the local memory store and recalled later by relevance × recency × use. Parallel to MEMORY.md and the memory graph. Writes ~/.agenticx/config.yaml.
memoryArchive.enableHint: Off by default. When on, each turn is written to the turns index asynchronously
memoryArchive.recallLimitHint: How many past chunks are injected into the system prompt
memoryArchive.minCharsHint: Shorter replies are not archived alone
memoryArchive.maxChunksHint: Cap on chunks written to the turns table per turn
memoryArchive.saved: Saved. The archive switch applies to new chats; recall settings apply on the next turn.

memoryGraph.title: Memory graph
memoryGraph.clickNode: Click a node to see its summary and time range
memoryGraph.pickGroup: Choose a group to view its memory
memoryGraph.pickAvatar: Choose an avatar to view its memory
memoryGraph.disabledHint: When on, entities and relations from chat are shown as a force graph. Parallel to text memory.
memoryGraph.installHint: Install graphiti-core, then finish a few chats
memoryGraph.emptyHint: After chats with names/relations, click refresh. Ingest is async; wait a few seconds.
memoryGraph.partialNote: Recent / frequent snippets, not the full memory
memoryGraph.settingsIntro: A visual view of structured temporal memory. Text search still uses WorkspaceMemoryStore. They run in parallel.
memoryGraph.enableHint: Off by default. When on, ingest is async
memoryGraph.retentionHint: Auto-clean episodes over the count/day limits (0 = no limit)
memoryGraph.buildModelHint: Entity/relation extraction uses an LLM; vectors use an embedder. Empty follows the global default provider{{current}}.
memoryGraph.pickProviderFirst: Choose a provider first, or add visible models in Model providers
memoryGraph.addVisibleModels: Add visible models in Model providers first
memoryGraph.textMemoryMeta: Meta-agent long-term memory (MEMORY.md). Global user preferences are under Display → User profile.
memoryGraph.textMemoryOther: This subject’s MEMORY.md, including preferences it inferred. You can edit it.
memoryGraph.deletingHint: Deleting. Do not click again or quit. If an item hits a graph-engine bug, the graph store is rebuilt from backup (up to about 1 minute).
memoryGraph.cleanConfirm: About {{count}} episodes will be deleted under the current retention policy (pinned stay).
memoryGraph.disabledHintConfig: Memory graph is off. Enable it above, or edit ~/.agenticx/config.yaml.
memoryGraph.notAvatarPane: This pane is not an avatar chat. Open an avatar pane to see its memory.
memoryGraph.notGroupPane: This pane is not a group chat. Open a group pane to see group memory.
memoryGraph.graphitiMissing: graphiti-core is not installed in the current agx serve environment
memoryGraph.graphitiMissingAt: graphiti-core is not installed on this backend ({{exe}}). Run: {{hint}}
memoryGraph.repairing: Memory graph data is damaged. Repairing…
memoryGraph.restoredBackup: Memory graph restored from backup. Loading…
memoryGraph.rebuiltEmpty: Memory graph was rebuilt empty. Later chats will write new memory.
memoryGraph.loadFailed: Failed to load the memory graph
memoryGraph.allPinned: All selected episodes are pinned and cannot be deleted
memoryGraph.retryAfterUrlChange: Backend URL changed. Close the dialog and delete again.
memoryGraph.backendHung: Backend is not responding (it may still be deleting or has quit). Wait about 1 minute, then Refresh. Do not delete again. If it still fails, ⌘Q quit Near and reopen.
memoryGraph.deletedRefreshFailed: Deleted, but the list failed to refresh. Click Refresh.
